ARG NODE_VERSION=20
FROM node:${NODE_VERSION}-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev \
    && npm cache clean --force
ENV PORT=8080 \
    NODE_ENV="production"
EXPOSE 8080
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s CMD curl -f http://localhost:$PORT/ || exit 1
RUN <<EOF
echo "multi line"
apk add --no-cache curl
EOF
USER node
ENTRYPOINT ["node", "server.js"]
CMD ['--port', '8080']

ARG NODE_VERSION=20
ARG BASE="node"
FROM --platform=$BUILDPLATFORM node:${NODE_VERSION}-alpine AS build
FROM ${BASE}:latest as final
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=build --chown=node:node package*.json ./
COPY ["a.txt", "b.txt", "/dest/"]
ADD --checksum=sha256:abc https://x.com/a.tar.gz /tmp/
RUN npm ci --omit=dev \
    && npm cache clean --force
RUN ["/bin/bash", "-c", "echo hi"]
ENV PORT=8080 NODE_ENV=production
EXPOSE 8080/tcp 9090
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.source="https://x" version=1.0
USER node:node
VOLUME ["/data"]
STOPSIGNAL SIGTERM
SHELL ["powershell", "-command"]
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s CMD curl -f http://localhost:$PORT/ || exit 1
ONBUILD RUN echo x
MAINTAINER x <x@y.z>
ENTRYPOINT ["node", "server.js"]
CMD ["--port", "8080"]
CMD node server.js
